evidence.observation: Purge brought exhaust O2 down from about 28,800 ppm to single-digit ppm, and it stayed low through the ramp and growth
Temperature followed the ramp setpoint closely, overshot to 759.5 °C when growth started, then settled at 750.0 °C
Heater power fell from 82% at the end of the ramp to 37–45% during the hold, as expected once the ramp stops
Argon flow is steady at about 100 sccm, matching the setpoint
Tube pressure is stable at about 760 Torr throughout

args.missing_evidence: No characterization of the sample yet, and no normal-run reference ranges were provided to check the hold-stage heater power against.
